toolQuick.title: Quick FAQ
toolQuick.intro: Quick answers to common questions. For the source of truth, use official DV Program pages.

q1.question: Is this an official website?
q1.answer: No. DV Photo Fix is independent and not affiliated with the U.S. government.

q2.question: Does this tool guarantee acceptance?
q2.answer: No. It helps with formatting and framing, but acceptance is decided by the official review process.

q3.question: Does the tool edit my face or “beautify” my photo?
q3.answer: No. It only applies safe geometric changes: crop, center, straighten, resize, and compress. No facial retouching.
